reviews.title: They took my money and cancelled the flight the next day, No refund.
reviews.text: Don't fly with Kulula- they are thieves. They took my money THE DAY BEFORE they cancelled all their flights and now they won;t give me a refund. I've emailed them about 30 times with NO RESPONSE. I've had to book alternative flights whilst still being out of pocket for their suspended flights. DO NOT BOOK WITH KULULA.

reviews.title: Poorest services ever in a plane
reviews.text: I received the worst service ever n the staff was very rude n arrogant,not willing to help at all the guy in charge with glass n dread locks n glass was very rude with his staff the ladies even spoke to me in xhosa yet l couldn't understand n l was talking to them in English n it was my wyf s birthday l chose khulula n l regret. reviews.author: Tawanda Charlton machererre

reviews.title: Bad service Kulula
reviews.text: Booked return tickets from Durban to Cape Townfor 2 passengers, on 06 May 22. My cheque account got debitted twice for the same amount, on 11 May 22 and 12 May 22. Had I not picked this up myself,am not sure if kulula would have refunded this. I called the call center today on 13 May 22 and was told it will take 6 to 8 weeks to refund this money,once I furnished them with my bank statements,showing this double deduction. I sent an email to a Charity Tyala and not even a reply email,confirming receipt of my query and supporting documents. Very bad service to have to wait almost 2 months,for a no fault issue on my part.
reviews.author: Vishal

reviews.title: rebooked to other flight without any notice
reviews.text: e got rebooked from our original flight at 12:10 from (Joburg --> Cape town) to a British Airways flight 7 hours later without any notice from the airline. Not even an email. We found out that we got rebooked to this other flight because our booking code did not work anymore when we tried to log in. Thereafter, I phoned kulula to figure out what happened to our booking a found out we got rebooked. however, I phone from the Netherlands to South Africa which resulted in giant phone bills. Noting they would do for us at the airport as well. In conclusion, worst service of any airline I have ever used.
reviews.author: Brian V

reviews.title: First try some else to fly with if no choice walk
reviews.text: Have to say the worst Wellcome then you board the plan, you get the feeling that we have to be here but don't want to be here, after take off the green curtain get closed and stays closed the whole flight, you only see the personel then the come around to sell you overpriced food and drinks, then then you want Chips sorry we don't have but we have nuts, the the intercom is used to relay a message you cannot here that is said, after the service a very quick clean of the cabon and the personel hides behind the green curtain, then the pilot say prepare for landing green curtain opens but nobody will do a walk around to see is all devices in off, lady in front of me had here video on the whole time even then coming in to land. Then we left the plane no one were at the door to say goodbay have a great evening. If i have a choice KULULA will be the last choise.

reviews.author: LaurenceD

reviews.title: Disgusting service
reviews.text: Kulula was grounded from 12 to 16 March and we were forced to book alternative flights for 18 and 21 March as we had no idea when they were going to start flying again. We were forced to call and bank the flights and I have now found out that they refuse to refund us and that the flights weren't actually banked. They stole R4000 from us and have lied to us about it. I hope this company rots in hell
reviews.author: Brett W

reviews.title: Kulula forgetting to send Confirmation of Booking Email.
reviews.text: I booked twice with Kulula in 1 month and both times they didn't send me a confirmation email with my booking reference. Both times I had to waste airtime calling Kulula to resend the email. The second time, I waited 10 minutes to be directed to a Kulula agent, who then was chatting to their coworkers for another 5 minutes and by the end of the call, still hadn't sent through a confirmation booking email, which created complications at the airport. Definitely avoiding booking a flight through them for the next while. Had the same problem happen with a friend who booked through them recently. Get it together Kulula.
reviews.author: Erin Ollewagen

reviews.title: Dishonest airlines.  0 customer service.   Apaaling
reviews.text: I am appalled by this airlines still being able to operate. Due to covid, flying from UK all flights were cancelled. They contacted me to let me know we can change our tickets, after they cancelled. Lies, I had a voucher valid until 31 July 2022. My partner and myself tried to get through only with negative responses, they cannot do anything about it. Avoid ,avoid at all costs. I will make sure to let everyone I know in South Africa know about their total lack of customer service.
reviews.author: Petra26

reviews.title: Terrible, after years of support
reviews.text: Kulula has gone backwards over the years - so much so that I will not be recommending this airline to anyone again. Staff are mostly blunt and unfriendly, interior of aircraft is outdated and falling apart, and overall service is just not up to standard. Very unhappy.
reviews.author: Anton

reviews.title: Awful Experience and Run Around
reviews.text: I did not get to fly with Kulula. I cancelled my flight 13 days in advance. Received a reply that I can get no refund, no voucher BUT Kulula would hold my ticket for 6 months. I realize that was a lie now, as they promise to re-activate the ticket, but 7 calls later to the call center, and they keep giving me the run-around. All kinds of excuse about a supervisor on lunch, etc. Very disappointing. I will never use this airline again. Seems I am one of many who has been burnt.
reviews.author: yvonnedow

reviews.title: Kulula flights
reviews.text: Pathetic customer service!!! Our flight changes without advance notice and we’re having to make alternative travel arrangements due to their unprofessional operating style and service. Furthermore, we’re unable to get a refund - It’s not our issue if you cannot run an airline and are currently in business rescue!
reviews.author: Nicole G

reviews.title: BOOK IN SERVICE TERIBLE
reviews.text: The book-in service in respect of booking in your luggage and getting your boarding pass was terrible. They had only 3 staff on duty who were extremely slow. This resulted in us just making our flight.
reviews.author: BARRYBE

reviews.title: FLIGHT ON TIME
reviews.text: Had to fly to Johannesburg to take a British Airways flight to London. It was a clear day and the flight was fine. the flight was on time so we had plenty of time to catch our next flight.
reviews.author: BARRYBE

reviews.title: Consistently delayed
reviews.text: I’ve been flying Kulula for many years and in my numerous flights, the airline is consistently delayed. Due to my vitality benefit discount, flying with Kulula ends up being one of the most cost effective airlines hence the repeat usage . However, poor operations is evident. In addition to this, the cleanliness of the plane is not up to standard. I have flown with FlySafair and my experience has always been pleasant - flight on time, clean plane, & friendly staff. Would highly recommend.
reviews.author: Tarryn Nicole G

reviews.title: Inconvenient
reviews.text: The inefficiencies compounded. The flight left late because the plane wasn't ready having landed late and disembarking passengers whilst cleaning. The price is steep and really the airline can do better. Passengers are treated like cattle with really no concern for time or convenience - take it or leave it!
reviews.author: Stan K

reviews.title: Be aware of the lack of common sense and worse their customer service! Do not fly Kulula airways in South Africa.
reviews.text: Took a return flight from Cape Town to Johannesburg on 26 Feb 2022. We were 4 px with 3 check in bags. 2 bags were 19 & 20 kg respectively and another at 22kg. The check in person insisted we remove 2kg even though we were entitled to have another bag at 20kg included. A bit of common sense, which clearly the Kulula staff don’t have would have resolved the issue. We eventually removed the 2kg and just carried it on. No difference to the weight on the plane. The frustration bit was that on our outbound flight passenger were allowed over 3kgs grace. Having spoken to friends in SA locally this is an airline to avoid. Rather pay a few pounds more and book with SAFair, BA or even SAA. Beware International travellers as you will be asked to remove kgs as your international flight entitles you to 23kgs. Other airlines in South Africa are much more flexible.
reviews.author: Kamlesh H

reviews.title: Mr
reviews.text: Flight was cancelled due to covid. Was told tickets stay valid for 12 months. All attempts now to reclaim ticjkets was fruitless... Dont use Kulula as this us the same as stealing your money. Rather use Lift or Safair as the reimbursed all our oast tickets in some way.
reviews.author: Beukes

reviews.title: Booking service
reviews.text: Kulula is the worst, tried to change initial booking to not be a round trip, app could not change it. Phoned call center 4 times. They advised me to not cancel the first leg and only change the return leg booking. So when I did not fly the first leg they canceled my booking and when I wanted to fly the return leg the booking was canceled. I ended up paying 3 times the rate for one flight. Kulula will never see me again
reviews.author: Izandre

reviews.title: British Airways operated by Comair purchased via Kulula
reviews.text: Broken hard shell suitcase and missing personalised luggage strap. Copious amounts of time trying to find correct way to report this - REPORT AT THE AIRPORT before you leave regardless of how delayed the service is. In an email responded to weeks later, they say the handle of the suitcase is broken, clearly visible is the hard plastic next to the handle that is broken. No phone number to talk to someone, days to reply to email, and pretending they don't understand the point. These people are giving us South African's a bad name.
reviews.author: Heidi G

reviews.title: Use another airline!!!!!!
reviews.text: So over flying Kulula. This must be the 10th time that I get an sms on the morning of my flight to say they've rescheduled my flight to leave later by 2 hours. I cannot arrange my business trips when you get stuffed around by this utter nonsense. My advice to anyone using Kulula - cancel and use any other airline. They would easily be more reliant.

reviews.title: Poor service, terrible quality
reviews.text: I'm at the airport and there's one person to attend to all people checking in/dropping bags. Usually checking in online will save you time as there is USUALLY a second line for bag drop. Yet with kulula this is not the case. Standing around for 40 minutes while you wait for the hundreds in front of you to be serviced by one person (mind you there are at least 10 desks unmanned) is not fun at all. Wouldn't recommend to anyone.

Tried phoning and emailing them with no answers even today no-one have come back to me. Will never fly with them again

reviews.title: Terrible flight
reviews.text: Terrible flight very stuffy. There was NO window in row 11 and we were squashed. The air was hot there was no aircon circulation. The flight landed 15 min later the landing took for ever we were hovering for ages made us sick
reviews.author: Xyz

reviews.title: No window and barely any footspace
reviews.text: Specifically chose a spot to sit at the window and when i got to that spot it was the only row that had no window. My knees got squeezed because of the feet space.
reviews.author: Me

reviews.title: Very Negative Experience
reviews.text: DO NOT BOOK WITH THIS AIRLINE!!!! We booked a domestic flight for our planned 3 week trip trip to south africa from Ireland. Covid meant our flights leaving Ireland was suspended. The customer service was horrendous - I received no reply to repeated messages and emails sent. They were not willing to refund the 200 euro spent. A friend in South Africa did get through to them eventually and the only option they gave my son and I was to pay more money to rebook flights within 5 months yet flights are still suspended??? This is not realistic nor is it helpful and quite appalling given that our inability to get to South Africa is completely out of our control. All other agents whom we booked with in South Africa kindly refunded our money. I would subsequently advice people not to book with this airline period given our negative experience overall.
reviews.author: Adele
